results.title: Home page loads with headline and job count
results.steps: Open the home page
results.expected: HTTP 200, headline shown, job count equals live data
results.actual: HTTP 200, headline shown, 3598 jobs listed (matches data)

results.title: Header links and logo
results.steps: Click Employers, Countries, Guides, then the logo
results.expected: Each opens its page; logo returns home
results.actual: Employers, Countries, Guides open the right pages; logo returns home

results.title: Role quick-filter chips
results.steps: Open each of the 8 role chips
results.actual: All 8 role chips open their role page (HTTP 200)

results.title: Footer pages (About, Contact, Privacy, Terms)
results.steps: Open each footer page
results.expected: Pages load with the required content
results.actual: About, Contact (email shown), Privacy (mentions Google ads), Terms all load

results.title: Unknown address shows a 404 page
results.steps: Open a made-up address
results.actual: HTTP 404 with the friendly 'left the gate' page and a link back

results.title: No broken internal links
results.steps: Follow every internal link from the home page
results.actual: Crawled 700 pages and files; no broken internal links

results.title: Search by job title (case-insensitive)
results.steps: Type a common title word in capitals, click Search jobs
results.expected: Only matching jobs; count equals data
results.actual: Search 'ENGINEER' (upper case) found 1203 jobs, matching the data; case-insensitive

results.title: Search by employer name with Enter key
results.steps: Type an employer name, press Enter
results.actual: Search 'RTX (Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney)' with Enter key found 602 jobs, matching the data

results.title: No results and clearing the search
results.steps: Type nonsense, then clear the box
results.expected: 'No jobs match' message; clearing restores all
results.actual: No-match search shows the 'No jobs match' message; clearing it restores all jobs

results.title: Country and region filter
results.steps: Pick the busiest country, then its region
results.actual: Country US: 1754 jobs; region North America: 1887 jobs; both match the data

results.title: Job role filter
results.steps: Pick each role in turn
results.actual: Each role matches the data: cargo-logistics=66, corporate=2151, customer-service-sales=108, engineering-maintenance=1240, flight-operations=17, ground-operations=9, pilots=7

results.title: Work mode filter (single and combined)
results.steps: Tick On-site, Hybrid, Remote one at a time, then two together
results.actual: Single modes On-site=3266, Hybrid=252, Remote=80; Hybrid+Remote together = 332

results.title: Posted date filter
results.steps: Pick 24h, 48h, week, month, older
results.actual: Posted-date filters match the data: 24h=184, 48h=202, week=2168, month=3309, >month=289

results.title: Employer type filter
results.steps: Pick each employer type
results.actual: Employer types match: airline=5, airport=17, manufacturer=3576

results.title: Combined filters, then Clear all
results.steps: Set country + role + mode, then Clear all
results.expected: Combined count correct; Clear all restores everything
results.actual: Country+role+mode together = 1 (matches); Clear all restores 3598

results.title: Filters saved in a shareable link
results.steps: Open a link with filters, reload
results.expected: Filters applied from the link and kept on reload
results.actual: A shared link with filters opens with them applied (63 jobs) and survives reload

results.title: Newest first and Closing soonest
results.steps: Check default order, switch to Closing soonest
results.actual: Newest-first order correct; Closing-soonest puts 'Associate Engineer – Data Analytics' (closes 2026-10-06) first

results.title: Show more jobs
results.steps: Click Show more until all shown
results.expected: 25 at a time; button hides at the end
results.actual: Shows 25, then 50 after 'Show more'; button disappears after all 3598 are shown

results.title: Job details and Apply button
results.steps: Open a job
results.expected: Title, employer, dates; Apply opens employer site in new tab
results.actual: Job page shows title, employer, dates; Apply goes to globalhr.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com in a new tab
